name: SideProjectors

sources.title: SideProjectors submit — intent picker (sell / co-founder / showcase / sold)
SideProjectors homepage — marketplace for side projects
SideProjectors help — free submissions, no commission on sales
Third-party submission walkthrough of the SideProjectors flow

requirements: Account required — sign in via Google, GitHub, GitLab, Product Hunt, LinkedIn, or email/password
First choice is listing intent: sell, find a co-founder, showcase, or record a sale — it determines what the project page becomes
Categories: SaaS, Ecommerce/Shop, Blog, Website, Mobile, Desktop, Browser extension, Domain
All projects go through a review process before approval
preparation: For sale listings: asking price plus revenue and user metrics, tech stack
Decide the intent upfront — 'Sell' puts a for-sale badge on the listing
workflow: Open /submit (or /submit/type) and pick the listing intent
Sign in with an OAuth provider or email
Fill project details (name, description, category, images; price for sale listings)
Publish — project pages live at /project/<id> with an assigned numeric id
Listing appears in Latest Side Projects / category pages after review
watchFor: Listing is free and sales carry no commission, but paid memberships ($3/$6/$9 per month) ration marketplace outreach — free tier allows only ~3 owner contacts and 2 DMs/day, aimed at buyers not listers
Free tier is ad-supported with large sponsor panels
Picking the wrong intent changes how the project is badged — 'Showcase' is the directory-equivalent path for a live product
Submit pages render listing content publicly but the actual form requires login
countsAsLive: A public project page at sideprojectors.com/project/<id> appearing in Latest Side Projects or its type/category listing.
unknowns: Whether showcase listings get dofollow outbound links
Exact required fields per intent (form is behind auth)
